Our community strives to live a life of faith, prayer, service, and togetherness. Along with our regular community responsibilities, we actively participate in pastoral, social, educational, and charitable activities. Our community members make efforts to strengthen their spiritual life while reaching out to children, families, and people in need. Through these activities, we try to live our vocation with love, commitment, and a spirit of service.
1. Prayer Life of the Community

Prayer is the foundation of our community life. Every day, we come together for common prayers, Holy Mass, Eucharistic celebration, meditation, and personal prayer. Community prayer helps us to remain united, seek God's guidance, and receive strength to carry out our responsibilities with dedication.
2. Special Chain Adoration

A special chain of Eucharistic Adoration is organized in our community as an expression of our love and devotion to Jesus in the Blessed Sacrament. Community members participate in the adoration according to the allotted time and spend time in silent prayer, thanksgiving, intercession, and reflection. During adoration, we pray especially for the needs of the community, families, children, the Church, vocations, and people who are experiencing difficulties. This practice strengthens our faith and reminds us of the importance of remaining close to Christ.
3. Rosary Through the Field for Protection

The community members conduct the Rosary through the field as a special prayer for God's protection and blessings. While praying the Rosary, we entrust our community, surroundings, families, children, and all our activities into the hands of Mary and seek her intercession.

The community members conduct the Rosary through the field as a special prayer for God's protection and blessings. While praying the Rosary, we entrust our community, surroundings, families, children, and all our activities into the hands of Mary and seek her intercession.

This activity also gives us an opportunity to pray together outside the usual community setting. It creates a spirit of unity and reminds us that our work and surroundings should be placed under God's care.
4. Apostolate with Foster Home Children

Our community actively engages in apostolic ministry with the children in the foster home. We spend time with the children, listen to them, guide them, encourage them, and participate in various activities with them. We try to provide them with care, affection, emotional support, and a sense of belonging.

We also conduct prayer, value education, games, creative activities, celebrations, and other programmes according to the needs of the children. Through this apostolate, we try to communicate God's love through our presence and service.
5. Family Visits

Family visits are an important part of our pastoral and social ministry. We visit families to understand their situations, share their joys and difficulties, and offer encouragement and support. During the visits, we also pray with the families and listen to their concerns.
These visits help us to build good relationships with families and understand the realities they experience.
6. Catechism in the Parish

Our community members participate in catechism classes in the parish. We assist children in learning about the Catholic faith, Bible, sacraments, prayers, Christian values, and moral responsibilities.

Apart from teaching lessons, we encourage children to participate actively in the life of the Church. Through catechism, we try to help children develop a strong foundation in faith and grow as responsible and compassionate Christians.
7. Service in the Creche

The community also contributes to the activities of the creche. We spend time with the children and assist in their care and development. We engage them through play,songs, stories, drawing, learning activities, and simple value-based programmes.

The creche ministry gives us an opportunity to support young children and their families. It also enables us to understand the importance of early childhood care, education, nutrition, safety, and emotional development.
9. Community Celebrations and Feasts

We actively participate in the celebration of important feasts and occasions in the Church and in our community. These celebrations include prayer, Holy Mass, cultural programmes, fellowship, and sharing of joy with others. Such occasions strengthen community bonding and create a sense of belonging among the members.
Conclusion

Our community seeks to combine prayer, faith, service, and pastoral commitment in our daily life. Activities such as special chain adoration, Rosary through the field, apostolate with foster home children, family visits, catechism in the parish, and service in the creche provide meaningful opportunities to serve God and people.

Through these activities, we strive to become a community that is prayerful, compassionate, responsible, and committed to the needs of society. We are grateful to God for the opportunities given to us and pray for the grace to continue our mission with renewed faith, love, unity, and dedication.
